compose_export.single_container_compose_yaml:
services:
  kanban:
    image: thumbs-up-kanban:latest
    container_name: kanban-standalone
    ports:
      - "${PORT:-8080}:8080"
    volumes:
      - kanban_data:/var/lib/kanban/data
compose_export.migration_steps_markdown:
### PostgreSQL 16 Migration Runbook
1. Generate secrets
2. Download encrypted backup (.kbbak)
3. docker compose up -d postgres
4. kanban-ctl restore into PostgreSQL 16
